summary: Iter 58 backend + frontend E2E regression for DEC-1 Batch B Round 2 overhaul. All 33 pytests in test_dec1_v7_7.py PASS (2.4s). New /app/backend/tests/test_iter58_dec1_regression.py adds 9 endpoint-level checks — 9/9 PASS covering public decoder (job pipeline with poll), auth signup/login/me, admin login, Cathy statement list/upload/detail, and a state-aware paywall probe. Frontend smoke via Playwright confirmed: login, dashboard, statements list (many statement-row-* rows), decoder tool page (paste-text UI + testids), and statement detail page rendering DecoderResultView (data-testid=decoder-result-v2) with In Plain English summary, stream breakdown (Everyday Living / Independence / Care Management), anomaly summary, and quarterly balance panel — 0 console errors. Only environmental snag: public decoder submit from the UI hit the shared per-IP burst limit (10/hour) because the pytest run consumed the quota, so end-to-end decode-from-UI could not be exercised in this session — DecoderResultView was verified via existing seeded statement instead.

minor.issue: FastAPI `@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown')` still in use — 39 DeprecationWarnings in every pytest run. Migrate to `lifespan` handlers when convenient (not a runtime bug).

verified_features.evidence: POST /api/public/decode-statement (as cathy) → job_id + status=pending; poll /api/public/decode-job/{id} → status=done in <8s; result contains extracted, summary, audit (with anomalies list), line_items, period_label, input_method, document_pages, original_filename. Anomalies contained the 'pension_status_unknown' and 'sup_footer_missing' RULE_* flags.

Anonymous POST returned 429 with well-formed detail: {error:'cooldown_active', days_until_next_use:120, window_days:120, reset_at, last_used_at, message} — confirms the 120-day free-tier cadence per §2.5.
New iter58_<uuid>@example.com signup → 200, login → 200 with Bearer token, /api/auth/me → 200 with matching email. Cookie-less flow works via Authorization header.
POST /api/admin/login admin@wayly.com.au → non-5xx (TOTP challenge path); endpoint alive.
POST /api/statements/upload (multipart CSV) → 200 + job_id; poll /api/statements/upload-job/{id} → status=done; GET /api/statements returned list; GET /api/statements/<id> → 200.
Uploading the same file twice returned 409 DUPLICATE_EXACT with existing_statement_id + existing_uploaded_at — confirms Phase-1 duplicate-handling rebuild live.

trial30909 currently reports plan=family, subscription_status=trialing (state has drifted from the memo doc), so upload succeeds; if the account had plan=free/expired the middleware in server.py L6653 would return 402. Test is state-aware.
cathy login → /app; dashboard shows stream cards, chat preview, family thread, timeline (data-testid=dashboard-timeline-panel present). 0 console errors.
12+ statement-row-* testids present at /app/statements; statements-upload-cta and statements-archived-link visible.

Opened statement detail; [data-testid=decoder-result-v2] and [data-testid=statement-detail-page] both visible. Body contains 'Everyday Living', 'Independence', 'Clinical', 'Care Management', 'Quarterly', 'Balance', 'In Plain English' summary, anomaly count ('3 things worth a closer look'). 0 console errors.
GET /ai-tools/statement-decoder loads with data-testid=decoder-textarea, decoder-submit, 'Paste text / Upload file or photo / Forward by email' tabs. 0 console errors on page load.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate the remaining @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') hooks in server.py to FastAPI lifespan events to silence the 39 DeprecationWarnings (cosmetic).

(Data hygiene, not code) trial30909@example.com in the preview env is currently plan=family / subscription_status=trialing / trial_ends_at=2026-08-01 — it does NOT match the 'expired trial' role described in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. If the paywall path needs regular coverage, either (a) update the memo, (b) mongo-flip subscription_status='expired' + plan='free' before the paywall smoke, or (c) seed a dedicated `expired-trial@example.com` fixture user.

(Testing constraint) The public decoder is rate-limited to 10 attempts/hour per IP even for authenticated Family users (server.py _rl 'tools_unauth_ip'). Backend pytest ran ~5 decode/upload jobs and exhausted the UI-side quota for the same session — end-to-end 'Decode this statement' click from /ai-tools/statement-decoder returned 429 with the correct UX copy ('You've made too many attempts. Please wait 49 minute(s) and try again.'). Frontend UX is correct; consider whether that limit should apply to paid users too (currently _rl.enforce runs BEFORE the paid-plan bypass in _enforce_statement_decoder_limit).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L2586: `await _rl.enforce(request, ('tools_unauth_ip', ...))` runs BEFORE the `user.plan in PAID_PLANS or _trial_active(user)` bypass, so paid Family users also get burst-limited to 10/hour on the public decoder. The docstring says 'even paid users, to absorb scraping/abuse' — intended, but worth confirming with product because the UI copy says 'wait 49 minutes' which surprised the tester on a paid account.
server.py L1251 upload_statement uses `get_current_user_id` (401 on unauth), then middleware at L6653 gates writes for read-only users. Two-layer gating is correct.

Public decode job result payload keys are `extracted`, `audit`, `summary`, `line_items`, `anomalies`, `period_label`, `input_method`, `document_pages`, `original_filename`. If any downstream code (frontend `decoderExport.js` etc.) still expects `extracted_json` / `audit_json` aliases, verify the alias mapping. DecoderResultView on the statement detail page already handles both shapes because it consumes the persisted statement doc, not the raw job payload.
test_dec1_v7_7.py imports server.py, which triggers the deprecated `@app.on_event` warnings 39× per run — acceptable, and unrelated to Batch B Round 2 changes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login + dashboard + statements list + statement detail + decoder page — 0 console errors; end-to-end 'Decode this statement' click could not be exercised due to shared 10/hr IP burst limit)

test_credentials: Used cathy@example.com / testpass123 (family plan) and trial30909@example.com / TrialPass1! (currently trialing, not expired in this env). Admin admin@wayly.com.au / Admin!2026 — endpoint responds, TOTP flow not exercised.
seed_data_creation: Created /tmp/test_stmt.csv (6-row synthetic HCP statement) and one uniquely-named CSV per Cathy upload test to avoid the DUPLICATE_EXACT 409. No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DEC-1 Batch B Round 2 backend + DecoderResultView frontend are healthy. Regression file /app/backend/tests/test_iter58_dec1_regression.py is idempotent and safe to re-run — it randomizes upload payloads with uuid to avoid the 409 duplicate. If you need to exercise the public decoder from the UI end-to-end, either wait 1 hour for the burst window to reset, or bump `_rl` limits in the preview env. To make the paywall smoke deterministic, either seed a dedicated expired-trial fixture user or `db.users.updateOne({email:'trial30909@example.com'}, {$set:{plan:'free', subscription_status:'expired'}})` before running.
rca_of_the_issue: No production bugs found. The three initial red flags — (1) public decoder returning job_id instead of the flattened result, (2) statements/upload returning job_id, (3) trial30909 upload returning 200 — were all correct behaviour: (1)+(2) reflect the async pipeline that lands answers in /api/public/decode-job/{id} and /api/statements/upload-job/{id} (the K8s-timeout fix documented in server.py L1257-L1260), and (3) reflects the current subscription_status of the test account in this preview env. All were resolved by adjusting the tests to poll the job endpoints and by making the paywall test state-aware.
